name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 28 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2026-02-17, at wavelengths from 0.91 to 4.55 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
